caption:
The video captures a wooden table holding a large pyramid built from upright dark-blue dominoes, ringed by a curved trail of white dominoes. A green plastic ramp, a small stack of flat cards, and two vertical white blocks sit at the pyramid's front base, with windows and a patterned wall behind. After a brief still moment, the white domino line on the right begins to topple in a sequential chain, and the shorter white block tips into the falling white pieces near the ramp edge.

The tall white block then leans down across the front-left of the structure near the ramp, while the toppling white trail continues along the right side. Soon the front-left face of the blue pyramid gives way, its dominoes tumbling with visible motion blur. The collapse spreads through the structure, degrading the tall pyramid into a low, scattered heap of blue and white pieces, with the green ramp, card stack, and far white trail still remaining in place.
